dailyTip.title: 💡 Daily Interview Tip
dailyTip.tip1: Use the STAR method (Situation, Task, Action, Result) to keep your answers structured and memorable.
dailyTip.tip2: Add specific numbers and outcomes to prove the impact of your work.
dailyTip.tip3: Take 2-3 seconds to pause before answering — it shows composure, not hesitation.
dailyTip.tip4: Keep each answer focused on one strong example instead of listing many weak ones.
dailyTip.tip5: Research the company's latest product launches or news before your interview.
dailyTip.tip6: Prepare 3 genuine questions to ask the interviewer to demonstrate your interest.
dailyTip.tip7: Avoid filler words like "um", "uh", and "like" by practicing answers out loud daily.
dailyTip.tip8: Mirror the calm energy of the interviewer — composure always wins.
dailyTip.tip9: Tailor each answer to the specific job description and company values.
dailyTip.tip10: End each answer with a brief summary sentence to reinforce your key point.
